# BTicino C300X v1.9.8 — Minims HTTPS prerelease

## 2026-10-15

This test release adds HTTPS callbacks for Home Assistant installations that
only accept HTTPS. It includes the integration and native agent `1.9.8-https.1`.

- Event subscriptions and the display bridge use the device's existing libcurl.
- TLS verifies the certificate chain and hostname. Redirects, environment
  proxies and automatic HTTP fallback are disabled.
- Home Assistant preserves HTTPS hostnames and recognises HTTPS-capable agents.
- Existing HTTP callbacks, Smartphone forwarding and video handling are retained.

## Installation

Add `https://github.com/Minims/ha-bticino-c300x` as a custom **Integration**
repository in HACS and enable beta releases. Install this version, restart
Home Assistant, then update the device agent through the integration.
Use the HTTPS hostname and port of Home Assistant as the callback base URL.
Do not install two copies of the `bticino_c300x` integration.

## Validation and limits

The ARMHF binary was built for Cortex-A9 / VFPv3 / NEON and checked against
the C300X 1.7.19 firmware libraries. ABI and stack checks pass, as do 282
targeted tests. The nine tests needing a local TLS server were blocked by the
build environment. HTTPS callbacks on the physical device remain unverified.

This is a prerelease, not an upstream release. The bundled ZIP is built locally;
GitHub Actions validation is separate. No device firmware is included.
